notes.title: 🔹 Development update: Section B complete and section C already underway! 🔹
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606342/6a75192ed7c5b6e7f233c5a66df0c10da85c8a43.png"]

Hi everyone!





I’m really excited to share some great news: Section B of Cube Mind is now complete! This second part of the game introduced new mechanics and a different aesthetic, which increased the complexity of the puzzles.



With Section B finished, I have now moved on to developing Section C, the final part of the game. Section C brings a more intense and surreal atmosphere, with its own color palette and mood, and closes the journey with even more complex puzzles and new mechanics.



As some of you may have noticed, I also updated the Steam store page with new screenshots showing the visual style of each section. Each part of the game is designed to be unique, while maintaining the neon cyberpunk identity of Cube Mind.



Here are some new screenshots from Section B and first looks at Section C:





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606342/9ac915a5066ad6f5965a64f154bfe628e6185fc5.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606342/7cf93167475b7d00b627f4bc164ed73aca3e228a.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606342/43dc208a68b9612c9674ae45c790863ec35b0341.png"]

I would love to know which atmosphere you like best so far: A, B, or C?



Thank you so much for following the development and supporting us with wishlists. They really help bring the game closer to release!



👉 Don't forget: the free demo is available on Steam, and you can add the full version to your wishlist to receive a notification when it launches.

notes.title: 🔷 Section 0 Complete + New Visual Update!
notes.content:
Section 0 Complete + New Visual Update!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606342/6a75192ed7c5b6e7f233c5a66df0c10da85c8a43.png"]



Hi everyone!



It’s been a while since the last update, and I’m excited to finally share new progress on CUBE mind! 🚀



I’m excited to share that Section 0, the first of the three main sections of CUBE mind, is now completely finished!



Each puzzle in this section has been designed to introduce new mechanics and expand on the game’s core systems — and I’m really happy with how it all turned out.



Here’s a look at one of the puzzles from this section, now with the updated visual style:





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606342/83eeae724c85938208d8c498ed716955db5ac7a5.png"]

This level challenges you to carefully combine cubes and lasers to unlock the path forward. The core gameplay is the same — logic and spatial thinking — but now presented in a more polished and atmospheric setting.



With Section 0 complete, development is moving forward into the next phases of the game. Step by step, CUBE mind is getting closer to launch.



A huge thank you to everyone who has already tried the demo and added the game to their wishlist. We’ve just passed 200 wishlists, which is a big milestone and a huge motivation to keep pushing forward!





More news coming soon — and I’ll be sharing progress more regularly from now on. What do you think of this updated look compared to the demo? 👀



👉 Don’t forget to add CUBE mind to your Steam Wishlist if you haven’t yet — it really helps a lot and ensures you won’t miss future updates.
